name: neo-dashboard
vibe: A dark SaaS analytics dashboard coming alive. A persistent, continuously-flowing data shell — a near-black tinted surface with an ambient dot-grid, a drifting accent glow, a slow scan line and a vignette — runs behind every scene and matches across every cut. Live KPI cards count their stat values up beside drawn sparklines; full-width line/area charts draw themselves in while bar columns grow; a browser-chrome device-frame holds real dashboard screenshots; a logo-reveal CTA closes. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole interface — the surface tint, the panels, the borders, the grid, the glow, every chart series and the CTA, not just the text. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for SaaS and analytics products, dashboards, metrics/KPI stories, launch numbers, data-driven proof and anything that should feel sleek, techy and measured.
